basic_info.description: Don't miss this exceptionally priced and rarely available corner studio in the historic Art Deco Hamilton building. Bathed in natural sunlight from two exposures, this bright and airy home showcases panoramic views of western sunsets, city lights, Twin Peaks and Nob Hill through oversized windows. A stylish blend of classic period details and tasteful updates, the unit features wood floors, modern kitchen appliances, and large closet. Residents enjoy the Hamilton's timeless elegance and amenities, including a stunning 16th-floor observation deck, elegant ballroom with catering kitchen, peaceful fountain courtyard, and gym. The HOA covers most utilities (heat, electricity, water, garbage) and includes 24-hour front desk security, an on-site manager, and building maintenance. Located at the heart of the city, you're just steps from public transportation, shopping, restaurants, and nightlife. This is the perfect opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco historywith modern convenience.
